body_markdown:
Gamers around the world have been eagerly awaiting this week’s release of Grand Theft Auto VI


*,* and music is a foundational part of the legendary series: ahead of launch day, the


[GTAVI artist page on Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/artist/15o7qdDTBzs6xWRUYUtZc1) had 29 million monthly listeners.


As players get their hands on the long-anticipated game, they’ll also be able to dive deeper than ever into the music that soundtracks it. Starting today at 9 a.m. ET, fans in 33 markets can explore a dedicated Grand Theft Auto VI editorial world in the Spotify app. The destination gathers the game’s official soundtrack, in-game radio stations, and 25 years of GTA music history in one place.


## **What’s inside**


The GTAVI destination features the


[The Grand Theft Auto VI Official Playlist](https://open.spotify.com/playlist/37i9dQZF1DX6RSJAsEDz7H) —music from the game’s soundtrack (featuring new music from artists including


[Dua Lipa](https://open.spotify.com/artist/6M2wZ9GZgrQXHCFfjv46we) ,


[Playboi Carti](https://open.spotify.com/artist/699OTQXzgjhIYAHMy9RyPD) , and


[Lana Del Rey](https://open.spotify.com/artist/00FQb4jTyendYWaN8pK0wa) , alongside previously released singles from


[Travis Scott](https://open.spotify.com/track/2QrLrUqdSg5njDVEqq5QFp?si=0acbb67275214a92) **,**[Morgan Wallen](https://open.spotify.com/track/5qGziX9216V8hKJjGg8RtH?si=d4b7c818fb9c4117) and


[Tove Lo](https://open.spotify.com/track/4h3tY2zV4easaHEAbHVmgj?si=b84b44968e60461d) ), score, trailers, and other key moments.


Over 20 playlists from the in-game music radio stations and mixtapes will also be featured. They include stations hosted by


[Bad Bunny](https://open.spotify.com/artist/4q3ewBCX7sLwd24euuV69X) and


[RaiNao](https://open.spotify.com/artist/42LEQxfXLEuzdqorKBbUVN) (Cocoteo FM),


[Robyn](https://open.spotify.com/artist/6UE7nl9mha6s8z0wFQFIZ2) and


**Alex Consani** (Flash FM, back from Vice City),


[Morgan Wallen](https://open.spotify.com/artist/4oUHIQIBe0LHzYfvXNW4QM) and


Lana Del Rey (Back Country Radio),


[PinkPantheress](https://open.spotify.com/artist/78rUTD7y6Cy67W1RVzYs7t) and


[The Dare](https://open.spotify.com/artist/2mqiqsaX4LzFnUP7PmHGAb) (Stockyard FM), and


[JT](https://open.spotify.com/artist/39af15p0feaAOdL9DTRj3m) (Vice City Rap Radio). The playlists will fill out as fans play through the game and discover more music.


## **A look back**


Other elements of the destination sift through Grand Theft Auto franchise history. The


**GTA Series Museum** pairs one iconic song from each game—think of “Billie Jean” on Vice City’s Flash FM, “Nuthin’ but a ‘G’ Thang” as CJ returns to Grove Street in San Andreas, and “Sleepwalking” from the GTAV trailer—with commentary from Spotify editors.


Longtime fans can also visit


**Iconic Radios of Past GTAs** , eight classic stations paired with a short editor’s note. They include Emotion 98.3, K-DST, Vladivostok FM, and FlyLo FM.


## **Made for you**


**GTA Mixes** are personalized playlists for GTAIII, Vice City, San Andreas, GTAIV and GTAV.


**Grand Theft Auto Radio** , a personalized station drawing on every song from the series, now includes the GTAVI music. And a


**GTA Podcasts** shelf collects GTA-themed shows from gaming creators around the world.


## **More to come**


The world will keep growing over the coming months as fans play and Rockstar releases more music. Check out the official playlists below, and start exploring at


[spotify.link/grandtheftauto](https://spotify.link/grandtheftauto) .
